title: patch
description: A shader built for this replay target and substituted for the capture's own. The document has three shapes: `--encodings` reports only what the target builds, `--dump` adds the disassembly it wrote, and `--from` adds the compile result -- plus, with `--compare`, the before/after images and their difference.

shader.description: e.g. res1234: the capture's own shader

reflection.description: whether the engine has a reflection for it

entry.description: the entry point the source was compiled with

flags.description: how many --flag name=value pairs were passed

built.description: the new shader's id, e.g. res9001

compiler.description: the compiler's own message, when it had one

dumped.description: the disassembly file written, empty if none was

percentDiffering.description: a percentage with three decimals, as text
